consequence.statement: The KVStore subsystem in the Cilium status API shows state `Disabled` instead of state `OK` with message `Disabled` when the KVStore is disabled; consumers that check the state may see different results.

assertion.statement: The Cilium status API now reports the KVStore subsystem with state `Disabled` when disabled, instead of state `OK` with message `Disabled`.
